headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: The Hindu / Times of India / Deccan Chronicle
bullets_en: KTR demands white paper on investments realised in 3 years.
SC to hear INDIA bloc's poser plea on CEC on Dec 9.
Rayachoti Again Turns Battleground Over Gram Panchayat Nominations.
PM Modi Picks Up Indian Flag at Quad Meet, Trump Says ‘Save It’.
Marco Rubio says ‘zero’ information that U.S. outages are linked or caused by a malign actor.
bullets_ur: KTR ne 3 saalon mein aanay wali investment par white paper ka mutalba kar diya.
SC 9 December ko CEC par INDIA bloc ki darkhwast ki sunwai karega.
Rayachoti mein Gram Panchayat nominations par aik baar phir dangal ban gaya.
PM Modi ne Quad meeting mein Indian flag uthaya, Trump ne kaha 'Save It'.
Marco Rubio ka kehna hai ke U.S. outages kisi malign actor se jure honay ka zero saboot hai.
